Class RiskAssessment

java.lang.Object
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.optimizer.model.RiskAssessment
public class RiskAssessment extends Object
Aggregated risk assessment for the recommended deployment topology.

resiliencyScore is on a 0–100 scale: the engine starts at 100 and subtracts a fixed penalty per finding (floored at 0), so a lower score means more, or more severe, findings. overallSeverity is the worst severity present.
